ITEM 1 | Pale yellow scrambled egg, soft and fluffy with small curds and clumps, slightly moist with a faint sheen, some lighter cream-colored and deeper golden patches, a few darker flecks possibly herbs or pepper, piled in an irregular mound covering roughly 35-40% of a square white plate about 26 cm across, mound about 9 cm wide and 2-3 cm high at its tallest, sitting directly on the white plate with no visible sauce or garnish around it | 150

ITEM 2 | Small single crumbled-off piece of the same pale yellow scrambled egg, soft and slightly moist, about 2 cm across, lying separately to the right of the main mound on the white plate | 8
